### Choosing the Better Portion
Author: Candice Lucey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/choosing-the-better-portion.html
Passage: Luke 10:42
Points:
- Believers often exhaust themselves by tethering their identity to endless task lists rather than resting in Christ.
- Mary understood that sitting at the feet of Jesus to be spiritually filled is the most essential work.
- Faithful Christian service must flow from an overflowing, spiritually nourished heart rather than pride or self-effort.
- Taking time to rest in the Lord equips us to serve others joyfully and without resentment.

### Busyness Doesn’t Satisfy
Author: Doug Fields
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/busyness-doesnt-satisfy-homeword-september-10.html
Passage: Luke 10:41-42
Points:
- Martha was absorbed by the demands of hospitality, whereas Mary chose personal communion with Jesus.
- Unrelenting busyness and crowded schedules inevitably leave believers running on empty and weary in spirit.
- God invites us to slow our frantic pace and discover true fullness of life in His presence.
- Even amid legitimate daily responsibilities, prioritizing regular connection with Christ remains the best choice.
